html:
Shenwan Huiyun Center
Located in the Shenzhen Bay Super Headquarters Base with a total floor area of about 600,000 m², in a reclamation area adjacent to three main metro lines — a large urban complex oriented to residence, commerce and offices. Tower J: 356.7 m, 79 floors.

Located by Shenzhen Bay Houhai Park with a total floor area of about 358,000 m², a large urban complex integrating offices, serviced apartments and a hotel. Tower T7: 341.4 m, 76 floors.

Belt and Road: Steel construction advances the B6 warehouse project in Baodao, Indonesia
As Chinese construction expertise meets the opportunities of the Belt and Road Initiative, a modern project is taking shape in Semarang, Central Java, Indonesia. The B6 warehouse project supports the upgrading of regional warehousing and industrial supply chains.
International cooperation: DIALOG Group's Gideon and CPECC (M)'s Jia Qiang visit GSIN

Bhd., is the Malaysian subsidiary of China Petroleum Engineering & Construction Corporation. Chairman Zhang Feng and senior staff responsible for project delivery, fabrication and marketing welcomed the visitors.

title: GSIN
html:
Company Profile

To become a competitive green steel-building industrial group

GSIN was founded in June 1998 in Shenzhen International Low Carbon City, Longgang. The original profile records a site area of approximately 30,000 m² and annual capacity of approximately 32,000 tonnes. A national high-tech enterprise specializing in super-high-rise, long-span and prefabricated steel structures, it holds Grade I specialist steel contracting and Grade II building general-contracting qualifications. Formerly Shenzhen Jinxin Steel Structure Building Installation Engineering Co., Ltd., the company restructured in 2015 and listed on NEEQ in November 2016 (stock code 839696). It received 2015 industry 5A integrity recognition and national high-tech status. Its business integrates specialist design, factory fabrication and standardized installation. The profile records three buildings above 340 m, including Shenwan Huiyun Center and Shenzhen Bay One; 65 buildings between 100 and 300 m, including Bojin Business Plaza and Wongtee Tower; and 50 long-span steel projects, including Beijing Normal University Zhuhai Gymnasium with a 145 m span.
